sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手为了隐瞒她的身份，采取了极其极端的手段。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于查到了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，查明她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是档案之源（Casefile Presents）的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: In early June 2020, the City of London was in the middle of its first lockdown issued in response to the coronavirus pandemic.
sentences.zh: 2020年6月上旬，伦敦市正处于为应对新冠疫情而实施的第一次封锁之中。

sentences.en: For almost three months, UK residents had been ordered to stay at home to prevent spreading the virus, dubbed COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 近三个月来，英国居民一直被命令呆在家中，以防止被称为COVID-19的病毒传播。

sentences.en: When the weather was good, people would catch up with their friends and family outdoors, where there was less risk of spreading the virus in the fresh air.
sentences.zh: 天气好的时候，人们会去户外与亲朋好友聚会，在新鲜空气中传播病毒的风险较小。

sentences.en: But during the first week of June, temperatures were cool, prompting members of the public to want to socialise indoors instead.
sentences.zh: 但在6月的第一周，气温转凉，促使公众转而在室内进行社交。

sentences.en: The UK government reminded its citizens to remain cautious and continue meeting outside as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 英国政府提醒公民保持谨慎，并尽可能继续在户外会面。

sentences.en: Beba Henry was a respected social worker who took the community's health and safety seriously.
sentences.zh: 贝巴·亨利是一名备受尊敬的社工，她对社区的健康和安全非常重视。

sentences.en: So, as her 46th birthday approached on Friday, June 5, she decided to celebrate with a sunset picnic in a local park instead of a party at home.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着她46岁生日（6月5日星期五）的临近，她决定在当地公园举行日落野餐来庆祝，而不是在家开派对。

sentences.en: Restrictions on movement meant that only loved ones who lived within walking distance could attend, and it would be a fairly small gathering.
sentences.zh: 出行限制意味着只有居住在步行距离内的亲人才能参加，这将是一个相当小型聚会。

sentences.en: Undeterred, Beba sent text messages to friends with an invitation to attend.
sentences.zh: 贝巴没有气馁，她给朋友们发了短信，邀请他们参加。

sentences.en: Please bring a blanket, lights, snacks, and a drink of your choice.
sentences.zh: 请带上一条毯子、灯、零食和你选择的饮料。

sentences.en: Let's have a catch-up, play some sophisticated music, watch the sunset, and take it from there.
sentences.zh: 让我们叙叙旧，放点精致的音乐，看日落，然后看情况再定。

sentences.en: Included with the text was a Google Maps screenshot of the party's destination, a 250-acre park with open fields and small woods called Friant Country Park.
sentences.zh: 短信中附有一张派对目的地的谷歌地图截图，这是一个占地250英亩、拥有开阔田野和小树林的公园，名为弗里安特乡村公园。

sentences.en: It was located near Beba's home of Wembley in northwest London.
sentences.zh: 它位于伦敦西北部贝巴的家温布利附近。

sentences.en: One person who was able to attend the celebration was Beba's younger half-sister, 27-year-old Nicole Smallman.
sentences.zh: 能够参加庆祝活动的人之一是贝巴年轻的同母异父妹妹，27岁的妮可·斯莫尔曼。

sentences.en: Nicole, who was a freelance photographer and artist, lived in the neighbouring town of Harrow.
sentences.zh: 妮可是自由摄影师和艺术家，住在邻近的哈罗镇。

sentences.en: Despite their 20-year age difference, the sisters were close, and Nicole helped Beba prepare for the picnic.
sentences.zh: 尽管她们相差20岁，但姐妹俩关系很近，妮可帮贝巴准备野餐。

sentences.en: That evening, the two went to a supermarket to purchase snacks, then headed to Friant Country Park in Beba's Purple Audi.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，两人去超市买零食，然后开着贝巴的紫色奥迪前往弗里安特乡村公园。

sentences.en: Video footage from London's expansive CCTV network captured the two walking into the park side-by-side at 7.39pm, chatting together and smiling as they carried their supplies.
sentences.zh: 伦敦庞大监控网络拍摄的视频画面捕捉到两人于晚上7点39分并肩走入公园，她们带着物资，边走边聊，面带微笑。

sentences.en: The sisters selected a spot at the top of a hill, scattering cushions and blankets around.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩在山顶选了一个地方，周围散落着靠垫和毯子。

sentences.en: They had also brought some fairy lights and glow sticks to add a party atmosphere and provide light after the sun went down.
sentences.zh: 她们还带了一些串灯和荧光棒，以增添派对气氛，并在日落后提供照明。

sentences.en: As Beba's friends started to arrive, the sisters waved the lights in the air to draw their attention.
sentences.zh: 随着贝巴的朋友们陆续到达，姐妹俩在空中挥舞着灯光以引起他们的注意。

sentences.en: The spot where they were seated afforded a scenic view of London, and everyone snapped photographs of the pink and purple-streaked sky as the sun set and dusk fell.
sentences.zh: 她们坐的地方可以俯瞰伦敦的风光，当太阳下山、暮色降临时，大家都拍下了粉紫色交织的天空。

sentences.en: There was singing, dancing, laughing and chatting, as well as lots of eating and drinking.
sentences.zh: 现场有唱歌、跳舞、欢笑和聊天，还有大量的吃吃喝喝。

sentences.en: When it became dark and the hour grew late, Beba's guests began to depart.
sentences.zh: 天黑下来，时间也晚了，贝巴的客人们开始离开。

sentences.en: One by one, the partygoers said goodbye and headed home, until just Beba and Nicole remained.
sentences.zh: 派对的人一个接一个地告别并回家，直到只剩下贝巴和妮可。

sentences.en: Left alone to enjoy some time together, the two sisters chatted, danced and snapped photographs of themselves playing with the fairy lights.
sentences.zh: 只剩下两人单独享受时光，姐妹俩聊天、跳舞，并拿着串灯玩耍自拍。

sentences.en: Throughout the night, Nicole had been texting her boyfriend, Adam, via the messaging platform WhatsApp.
sentences.zh: 整夜，妮可一直在通过聊天软件WhatsApp给她的男朋友亚当发短信。

sentences.en: At 1.04am, she sent him a message that read,
sentences.zh: 凌晨1点04分，她给他发了一条信息写道：

sentences.en: The following morning of Saturday June 6, Wilhelmina Smallman decided to text her daughters, Beba and Nicole, to see how their picnic had gone.
sentences.zh: 第二天6月6日星期六，威廉米娜·斯莫尔曼决定给她的女儿们贝巴和妮可发短信，看看她们的野餐过得怎么样。

sentences.en: Wilhelmina, who went by the nickname, Mina, had been unable to attend Beba's party, as she lived in the coastal town of Ramsgate,
sentences.zh: 威廉米娜的小名是米娜，由于她住在沿海小镇拉姆斯盖特，未能参加贝巴的派对。

sentences.en: located almost 80 miles east from London in the county of Kent.
sentences.zh: 拉姆斯盖特位于伦敦以东近80英里的肯特郡。

sentences.en: But Beba and Nicole had made sure to send Mina photos from the celebration the previous night.
sentences.zh: 但贝巴和妮可特意给米娜发了前一天庆祝活动的照片。

sentences.en: Their family was close-knit.
sentences.zh: 她们的家庭关系很紧密。

sentences.en: As well as Beba and Nicole, Mina had a third daughter, Monique, who lived in Holland.
sentences.zh: 除了贝巴和妮可，米娜还有第三个女儿莫妮卡，住在荷兰。

sentences.en: Beba and Monique were Mina's children from her first marriage to Herman Henry, a retired boxer.
sentences.zh: 贝巴和莫妮卡是米娜与第一任丈夫、退休拳击手赫曼·亨利所生的孩子。

sentences.en: Nicole was her only child from her second marriage to Christopher Smallman.
sentences.zh: 妮可是她与第二任丈夫克里斯托弗·斯莫尔曼所生的唯一孩子。

sentences.en: Beba and Monique were close with their stepfather, and everyone got along extremely well.
sentences.zh: 贝巴和莫妮卡与她们的继父关系很好，每个人都相处得非常融洽。

sentences.en: At 11.23am, Mina sent her daughters a text message in response to some pictures they'd sent of the picnic.
sentences.zh: 上午11点23分，米娜给女儿们发了一条短信，回复她们发来的一些野餐照片。

sentences.en: Love the photo.
sentences.zh: 很喜欢这张照片。

sentences.en: Good turnout.
sentences.zh: 来的人挺多。

sentences.en: She added that she hoped they'd had a lovely time and asked them to tell her all about it later on.
sentences.zh: 她补充说，希望她们过得愉快，并让她们晚点把一切都告诉她。

sentences.en: To her surprise and concern, Mina didn't hear anything back from either of her daughters.
sentences.zh: 令她惊讶和担忧的是，米娜没有收到任何一个女儿的回音。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Nicole's circle of friends were also growing concerned.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，妮可的朋友圈也开始感到担忧。

sentences.en: Her boyfriend Adam had asked her to let him know when she arrived home safely, but she never did.
sentences.zh: 她的男友亚当曾让她到家后报个平安，但她一直没说。

sentences.en: Adam got in touch with Nicole's housemate, Emma, who said Nicole hadn't come home.
sentences.zh: 亚当联系了妮可的室友艾玛，艾玛说妮可没有回家。

sentences.en: The lack of contact was strange.
sentences.zh: 这种失联很不寻常。

sentences.en: Nicole loved animals and had a pet bearded dragon lizard whom she adored.
sentences.zh: 妮可很喜欢动物，养了一只她非常疼爱的宠物 bearded dragon 蜥蜴。

sentences.en: If she ever planned to be away for a longer period of time, she would provide instructions for his care, such as when to feed him or change his heat lamp.
sentences.zh: 如果她计划外出较长时间，她会留下照顾宠物的说明，比如什么时候喂食或更换加热灯。

sentences.en: But she hadn't done so this time.
sentences.zh: 但这次她没有这样做。

sentences.en: Emma contacted some mutual friends to see if they had heard from Nicole.
sentences.zh: 艾玛联系了一些共同的朋友，看他们是否听到妮可的消息。

sentences.en: None of them had.
sentences.zh: 他们谁都没有。

sentences.en: After Adam repeatedly called Nicole without success, he tried to trace her phone with a tracker app to no avail.
sentences.zh: 在亚当多次拨打妮可电话无果后，他试图用追踪软件定位她的手机，也没有结果。

sentences.en: Hoping that Nicole had decided to stay at Bieber's house, Adam travelled there to check.
sentences.zh: 怀着妮可可能决定住在比伯（贝巴）家里的希望，亚当赶往那里查看。

sentences.en: No one was home.
sentences.zh: 家里没有人。

sentences.en: By the time Saturday evening rolled around, Adam and Nicole's friends were becoming increasingly upset.
sentences.zh: 到了星期六傍晚，亚当和妮可的朋友们越来越心烦意乱。

sentences.en: When the women's mother, Mina, conferred with Adam and realised nobody had heard from Bieber or Nicole, she knew something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 当两人的母亲米娜与亚当商量，并意识到没有人听到比伯或妮可的消息时，她知道出事了。

sentences.en: At 10.42 that night, Mina called the police to report her daughters missing.
sentences.zh: 当晚10点42分，米娜打电话给警察报警称女儿失踪。

sentences.en: She told them what the situation was, how long it had been since anyone had heard from Bieber and Nicole, and provided a detailed description of where they were last seen.
sentences.zh: 她向警方说明了情况，距离大家最后听到比伯和妮可的声音已经过去多久，并详细描述了她们最后被看到的地方。

sentences.en: But Mina got the impression that the police didn't share her concern.
sentences.zh: 但米娜给人的印象是警察并不像她那样担忧。

sentences.en: They listened to her, but didn't seem to share her sense of urgency, and didn't indicate they would do anything to look for the women.
sentences.zh: 他们听了她的话，但似乎并不像她那样感到紧迫，也没有表示会做任何事情来寻找这些女性。

sentences.en: That night, Mina and her husband Christopher couldn't sleep.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，米娜和她的丈夫克里斯托弗无法入睡。

sentences.en: They continued trying to call and text Bieber and Nicole throughout the night, typing out one message after another.
sentences.zh: 他们整晚都在试图给比伯和妮可打电话和发短信，一条接一条地打字。

sentences.en: Where are you?
sentences.zh: 你们在哪里？

sentences.en: Getting quite worried here.
sentences.zh: 这里开始有点担心了。

sentences.en: Please let us know you are okay.
sentences.zh: 请让我们知道你们没事。

sentences.en: When Sunday morning rolled around, the women's loved ones knew they would have to do something.
sentences.zh: 当周日早晨来临时，两人的亲人知道他们必须做点什么了。

sentences.en: It had been more than 24 hours since Bieber and Nicole had been seen.
sentences.zh: 距离比伯和妮可被人看到已经过去24个多小时了。

sentences.en: Hoping that getting the word out on social media might help,
sentences.zh: 希望在社交媒体上发布消息可能会有所帮助，

sentences.en: Nicole's friends posted about Nicole's disappearance on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 妮可的朋友们在Facebook上发布了关于妮可失踪的消息。

sentences.en: They shared a photo of Nicole beneath the heading, Missing.
sentences.zh: 他们在“失踪”标题下分享了一张妮可的照片。

sentences.en: They also started phoning hospitals in the area to see if they had any patients matching the women's description.
sentences.zh: 他们还开始打电话给该地区的医院，看看是否有任何患者符合两人的体貌特征。

sentences.en: As the police still hadn't sent out search parties,
sentences.zh: 由于警察仍然没有派出搜救队，

sentences.en: Christopher Smallman made the decision to drive to London to conduct his own search.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗·斯莫尔曼决定开车去伦敦亲自搜寻。

sentences.en: Nicole's boyfriend Adam had the same idea.
sentences.zh: 妮可的男友亚当也有同样的想法。

sentences.en: Like Mina, he had called the police the previous night to report his girlfriend missing, but hadn't gotten anywhere.
sentences.zh: 和米娜一样，他在前一天晚上报警称女友失踪，但没有进展。

sentences.en: The police had told them they would pay a visit to Bieber's flat, so Adam and his mother had gone there to wait for them.
sentences.zh: 警察告诉他们会去比伯的公寓看看，所以亚当和他的母亲去那里等他们。

sentences.en: But the police never showed up and couldn't say when they would arrive.
sentences.zh: 但警察从未出现，也无法说明什么时候会到。

sentences.en: Accompanied by his parents, Adam decided to go to Friant Country Park, the place where the women were last known to have been.
sentences.zh: 在父母的陪同下，亚当决定去弗里安特乡村公园，这是人们最后知道女性去过的地方。

sentences.en: Once at the park, Adam met up with a friend of the sisters named Nina Resmat, who'd attended the picnic on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 一到公园，亚当就遇到了周五晚上参加野餐的姐妹俩的朋友妮娜·雷斯马特。

sentences.en: Nina had also been concerned after being unable to reach the women and had cycled to the park by herself hoping to find something.
sentences.zh: 妮娜在无法联系到两名女性后也很担心，便独自骑自行车去公园希望能找到点什么。

sentences.en: She'd spent about 30 minutes riding her bike around the enormous park looking for her friends.
sentences.zh: 她花了大约30分钟骑自行车绕着巨大的公园寻找她的朋友。

sentences.en: Nina took Adam and his parents to the top of the hill where Bieber's celebrations had been held.
sentences.zh: 妮娜带着亚当和他的父母来到山顶，比伯的庆祝活动就在那里举行。

sentences.en: The spot was a five-minute walk from the Valley Drive entrance to the park.
sentences.zh: 这个地方距离公园的峡谷大道入口步行五分钟。

sentences.en: It was surrounded by sprawling fields which were dotted with ponds and framed by denser areas of woodland.
sentences.zh: 它四周环绕着广阔的田野，田野里点缀着池塘，四周是更密集的林地。

sentences.en: No sign of the picnic held two nights earlier remained.
sentences.zh: 两天前举行的野餐没有留下任何痕迹。

sentences.en: All of the blankets, cushions and fairy lights that had been strewn around the top of the hill were now gone.
sentences.zh: 散落在山顶的所有毯子、靠垫和串灯现在都不见了。

sentences.en: The lack of items belonging to the sisters left the impression that they'd most likely packed up their things and left the park,
sentences.zh: 缺少属于姐妹俩的物品给人一种印象，她们很可能已经收拾好东西离开了公园，

sentences.en: rather than something happening to them while they were still there.
sentences.zh: 而不是在她们还在那里的时候发生了什么。

sentences.en: Regardless, the group still decided to search their surroundings.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，大家还是决定搜寻周围环境。

sentences.en: They split up and began scouring the area.
sentences.zh: 他们分头行动，开始在附近搜索。

sentences.en: While Adam and his parents went in other directions,
sentences.zh: 当亚当和他的父母走向其他方向时，

sentences.en: Nina combed through the large field at the base of the hill looking for anything out of place.
sentences.zh: 妮娜仔细搜寻了山脚下的大片田野，寻找任何不寻常的东西。

sentences.en: Then something caught her eye.
sentences.zh: 然后有什么东西吸引了她的眼光。

sentences.en: A mangled pair of expensive designer prescription sunglasses lay on the ground, glinting in the sun.
sentences.zh: 一副扭曲昂贵的名牌处方太阳镜躺在地上，在阳光下闪闪发光。

sentences.en: Nearby was a long patch of flattened grass.
sentences.zh: 附近是一长片被压平的草地。

sentences.en: Nina's heart sank.
sentences.zh: 妮娜的心沉了下去。

sentences.en: She immediately recognised the glasses as belonging to Bieber.
sentences.zh: 她一眼认出这副眼镜属于比伯。

sentences.en: The state of them didn't suggest that Bieber had left the park safely and of her own accord.
sentences.zh: 它们的状态并不表明比伯是安全地、自愿地离开公园的。

sentences.en: Uncertain what she should do now,
sentences.zh: 不确定现在该做什么，

sentences.en: Nina picked up her phone and called the police to report what she'd found.
sentences.zh: 妮娜拿起手机打电话给警察报告她发现的情况。

sentences.en: They told her to hand the glasses in to them, so Nina picked them up and hopped back on her bicycle to go to the nearest police station.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉她把眼镜交上来，于是妮娜捡起眼镜，跳回自行车去最近的警察局。

sentences.en: She continued to communicate with Adam via text.
sentences.zh: 她继续通过短信与亚当沟通。

sentences.en: He'd found nothing, and when he messaged Nina saying that he didn't know what to do, she replied,
sentences.zh: 他什么也没找到，当他发信息给妮娜说他不知道该怎么办时，她回答说：

sentences.en: If you can bear it, just keep looking.
sentences.zh: 如果你能忍受，就继续找。

sentences.en: Adam and his parents continued to search.
sentences.zh: 亚当和他的父母继续搜寻。

sentences.en: They called out the women's names, hoping desperately for a reply, while searching through scrub and vegetation.
sentences.zh: 他们大声喊着两人的名字，拼命希望得到回应，同时在灌木丛和植被中搜寻。

sentences.en: Adam spotted a second pair of sunglasses, but didn't touch them.
sentences.zh: 亚当发现了第二副太阳镜，但没有碰它们。

sentences.en: Then, Adam's father called out to him.
sentences.zh: 然后，亚当的父亲对他大喊。

sentences.en: Adam rushed over to the location his father was searching.
sentences.zh: 亚当冲向他父亲正在搜索的位置。

sentences.en: Nearby was a long trail of flattened grass, and lying on the ground was a black-handled knife with a 12cm blade.
sentences.zh: 附近有一长条被压平的草地，地上躺着一把带12厘米刀刃的黑柄刀。

sentences.en: It was engraved with the brand name,
sentences.zh: 上面刻着品牌名称，

sentences.en: Taylor's Eyewitness, and looked clean.
sentences.zh: 泰勒的目击者（Taylor's Eyewitness），而且看起来很干净。

sentences.en: Despite the clean blade, the sight left Adam panicked.
sentences.zh: 尽管刀刃很干净，但这一幕让亚当惊慌失措。

sentences.en: Pulling out his phone, he dialed 999, the emergency services number, and began explaining the situation to a dispatcher
sentences.zh: 掏出手机，他拨打紧急服务号码999，开始向调度员解释情况，

sentences.en: while running along the stretch of flattened grass at the same time.
sentences.zh: 同时沿着那段被压平的草地奔跑。

sentences.en: The trail led towards a strip of wooded area with a row of trees.
sentences.zh: 小路通向一片长着一排树木的林带。

sentences.en: Poking out from beneath some undergrowth was a pair of shoes.
sentences.zh: 从一些下木丛下露出了一双鞋子。

sentences.en: Adam ran around to a gap in the bushes.
sentences.zh: 亚当绕到一个灌木丛的缺口处。

sentences.en: Diving into the undergrowth, he was met with a horrifying sight.
sentences.zh: 冲进灌木丛，他看到一个可怕的景象。

sentences.en: About one foot away from him lay the bodies of two women intertwined together.
sentences.zh: 大约一英尺远的地方躺着两名交织在一起的女性尸体。

sentences.en: It was Bieber and Nicole.
sentences.zh: 那是比伯和妮可。

sentences.en: Both lay on their sides, and they were positioned top to toe.
sentences.zh: 两人都侧卧着，头脚相接的位置摆放着。

sentences.en: It looked as though they were locked in an embrace, with their limbs wrapped around one another.
sentences.zh: 看起来她们好像紧紧相拥，四肢缠绕在一起。

sentences.en: Bieber's clothing had been pulled up over her head.
sentences.zh: 比伯的衣服被拉到头上。

sentences.en: She had been stabbed eight times, and her back was covered in abrasions from being dragged through the rough undergrowth.
sentences.zh: 她被刺了八刀，后背满是被粗糙灌木丛拖拽造成的擦伤。

sentences.en: Nicole's clothing had been yanked up above her abdomen, and she too had abrasions and stab wounds.
sentences.zh: 妮可的衣服被拉到腹部上方，她也有擦伤和刺伤。

sentences.en: But Nicole's injuries were far more extensive than her sister's.
sentences.zh: 但妮可的伤势比她姐姐要严重得多。

sentences.en: She had been stabbed 28 times.
sentences.zh: 她被刺了28刀。

sentences.en: Her eyes were open, and as Adam looked at his girlfriend's face, he knew that she was dead.
sentences.zh: 她的眼睛睁着，当亚当看着女友的脸时，他知道她已经死了。

sentences.en: He fell to the ground and let out several guttural screams, which was heard by the 999 dispatcher on the other end of his phone.
sentences.zh: 他倒在地上发出几声低沉的尖叫，手机那头的999调度员听到了。

sentences.en: His parents also heard Adam's cries of distress and raced over towards him, but he leapt up to stop them from having to see what he'd seen.
sentences.zh: 他的父母也听到了亚当痛苦的哭声并朝他冲去，但他跳起来阻止他们看到他所看到的东西。

sentences.en: He handed his phone to his father and ordered his parents not to go into the bushes, then collapsed once again.
sentences.zh: 他把手机交给他父亲，命令父母不要走进灌木丛，然后再次瘫倒。

sentences.en: After hearing Adam's screams, a man in another area of the park flagged down a police officer and directed her towards the noise.
sentences.zh: 听到亚当的尖叫声后，公园另一区域的一名男子拦住了一名女警察，并引导她走向噪音方向。

sentences.en: She found Adam and his parents in a state of shock.
sentences.zh: 她发现亚当和他的父母处于休克状态。

sentences.en: The officer and a colleague entered the scene where the sisters' bodies lay and confirmed that both were deceased.
sentences.zh: 这名警察和一名同事进入姐妹俩尸体躺着的地方，确认两人均已死亡。

sentences.en: Officers from London's Metropolitan Police descended on the park.
sentences.zh: 伦敦大都会警察局的警察涌入公园。

sentences.en: With the ground stretching for 250 acres, they were facing an enormous crime scene.
sentences.zh: 由于土地面积达250英亩，他们面临着一个巨大的犯罪现场。

sentences.en: To preserve the area where Bieber and Nicole's bodies lay and prevent it being contaminated before forensic experts had a chance to examine it, officers set up a series of cordons.
sentences.zh: 为了保护比伯和妮可尸体躺着的区域，防止在法医专家有机会检查之前受到污染，警察设置了一系列警戒线。

sentences.en: The innermost cordon framed the hedgerow where the women's bodies were.
sentences.zh: 最内层的警戒线包围着女性尸体所在的树篱。

sentences.en: Mina Smallman was at home waiting anxiously for news when her phone rang with a call from Adam.
sentences.zh: 米娜·斯莫尔曼正在家里焦急地等待消息，这时亚当打来电话。

sentences.en: She answered and Adam told her,
sentences.zh: 她接了电话，亚当告诉她：

sentences.en: Mina, Mina, I need you to sit down.
sentences.zh: 米娜，米娜，我需要你坐下来。

sentences.en: We've found them, but they're gone.
sentences.zh: 我们找到了她们，但她们已经不在了。

sentences.en: Mina began to scream uncontrollably.
sentences.zh: 米娜开始无法控制地尖叫起来。

sentences.en: After her cries eventually subsided, she remembered that her husband was driving to Friant Country Park.
sentences.zh: 她的哭喊声终于平息后，她想起她的丈夫正开车前往弗里恩特郊野公园。

sentences.en: She phoned Christopher and broke the news to him that their girls had died.
sentences.zh: 她打电话给克里斯托弗，把他们的女儿们已经去世的消息告诉了他。

sentences.en: Although they knew there was no longer any way to help Bieber and Nicole, some of their loved ones felt a desire to go to the park and be there for them in the only way they could.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们知道已经没有任何办法帮助比伯和妮可了，但他们的一些亲人还是萌生了去公园的想法，以他们唯一能做到方式陪伴她们。

sentences.en: A small group gathered at the bottom of the hill before the cordons started and watched as forensic units arrived and officers went to and from the scene.
sentences.zh: 一小群人聚集在警戒线开始前的山脚下，看着法医小组到达，警官们进出犯罪现场。

sentences.en: As detailed in the BBC documentary Two Daughters, one of Bieber's relatives was extremely distraught and begged the officers to let him see Bieber.
sentences.zh: 正如英国广播公司纪录片《两个女儿》中所详细描述的那样，比伯的一位亲属情绪极其激动，恳求警官让他见见比伯。

sentences.en: Several officers were installed at the innermost cordon to guard the sisters' bodies until they could be removed for autopsy the following morning.
sentences.zh: 几名警官被部署在最内层的警戒线上，看守着姐妹俩的遗体，直到第二天早上将遗体运走进行尸检。

sentences.en: Forensic tents were set up so that members of the public wouldn't see the bodies being taken from the park.
sentences.zh: 现场搭起了法医帐篷，这样公众就不会看到遗体从公园被运走。

sentences.en: Further examinations confirmed that whoever had killed the two women had dragged them by the feet into the bushes and deliberately positioned them in the way they were found,
sentences.zh: 进一步的检查证实，杀害这两名女性的凶手把她们拖着脚拉进灌木丛，并刻意将她们摆成被发现时的姿势，

sentences.en: perhaps as a way to further degrade them.
sentences.zh: 也许是为了进一步羞辱她们。

sentences.en: 46-year-old Bieber Henry had sustained six stab wounds to her chest, one to her groin and one to her back.
sentences.zh: 46岁的比伯·亨利胸部中了六刀，腹股沟中了一刀，背部中了一刀。

sentences.en: The knife used in the attack had penetrated her lungs and heart, with one chest wound measuring 15 centimetres deep.
sentences.zh: 袭击中使用的凶器刺穿了她的肺部和心脏，其中一处胸部伤口深达15厘米。

sentences.en: This particular injury would have rendered Bieber unconscious within seconds.
sentences.zh: 这种特殊的伤势会在几秒钟内让比伯失去知觉。

sentences.en: She had no defensive wounds, indicating that her killer had caught her by surprise.
sentences.zh: 她身上没有任何防御性伤口，这表明她的凶手让她猝不及防。

sentences.en: Her 27-year-old sister, Nicole Smallman, would have been witness to her sister's attack.
sentences.zh: 她27岁的妹妹妮可·斯莫尔曼必然目睹了她姐姐遇袭的过程。

sentences.en: Unlike Bieber, Nicole had numerous defensive injuries and her attack had been far more brutal, likely because she had tried to fight back.
sentences.zh: 与比伯不同，妮可身上有大量的防御性伤口，她遭受的袭击要残忍得多，很可能是因为她曾试图反抗。

sentences.en: She had been stabbed 28 times and had injuries to her chest, back, thigh, hip, shoulder, arms and hands.
sentences.zh: 她被刺了28刀，胸部、背部、大腿、臀部、肩膀、手臂和手部都有伤。

sentences.en: Investigators appealed for anybody who had been at Friant Country Park on the evening of Friday, June 5 or early morning on Saturday, June 6 to come forward.
sentences.zh: 调查人员呼吁任何在6月5日星期五晚上或6月6日星期六清晨去过弗里恩特郊野公园的人站出来提供线索。

sentences.en: They described the location where Bieber and Nicole had been and said that if anyone had seen or heard anything suspicious,
sentences.zh: 他们描述了比伯和妮可所在的位置，并表示如果任何人看到或听到了任何可疑的事情，

sentences.en: then it was especially important that they share what they knew.
sentences.zh: 那么分享他们所知道的情况就尤为重要。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: Several witnesses did come forward.
sentences.zh: 确实有几位目击者站了出来。

sentences.en: At 1.45am on the morning of Saturday, June 6, a local woman named Elaine Williams had been at home watching television
sentences.zh: 6月6日星期六清晨1点45分，当地一名名叫伊莱恩·威廉姆斯的女子正在家中看电视，

sentences.en: when she suddenly heard a disturbance from the direction of the park.
sentences.zh: 这时她突然听到公园方向传来一阵骚动。

sentences.en: It sounded like a man shouting.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是一个男人的喊叫声。

sentences.en: This was followed by two female voices shouting back.
sentences.zh: 紧接着是两个女人的回喊声。

sentences.en: Then Elaine could only hear one woman's voice, followed by a blood-curdling scream.
sentences.zh: 然后伊莱恩只能听到一个女人的声音，接着是一声毛骨悚然的尖叫。

sentences.en: To Elaine, it sounded like a massive argument between two groups who didn't know each other.
sentences.zh: 在伊莱恩看来，这听起来像是两群互不相识的人之间发生的大规模争吵。

sentences.en: Later that morning, a man named Martin Ridgway headed to the park armed with several bin bags.
sentences.zh: 那天早上晚些时候，一个名叫马丁·里德威的男子拿着几个垃圾袋前往公园。

sentences.en: Martin was a member of Barnhill Conservation Group and would spend time picking up rubbish as part of that work.
sentences.zh: 马丁是巴恩希尔自然保护协会的成员，他会花时间捡垃圾作为这项工作的一部分。

sentences.en: As he made his way through the park looking for litter, Martin came across a large pile of abandoned belongings.
sentences.zh: 当他在公园里一边寻找垃圾一边前行时，马丁偶然发现了一大堆被遗弃的随身物品。

sentences.en: There were several cushions, two backpacks, a large blue hold-all bag, a white paper bag, and some food packaging.
sentences.zh: 有几个靠垫、两个背包、一个大的蓝色手提包、一个白色纸袋和一些食品包装。

sentences.en: Some of the items were covered in red marks, which Martin assumed were ketchup stains, as there were several empty saucepots amongst the detritus.
sentences.zh: 其中一些物品上沾有红色的痕迹，马丁以为那是番茄酱渍，因为在这些废弃物中有很多空的酱汁罐。

sentences.en: He threw the belongings away in some park bins.
sentences.zh: 他把这些随身物品扔进了公园的一些垃圾桶里。

sentences.en: Police were later able to track these items down.
sentences.zh: 警方后来追查到了这些物品。

sentences.en: The following morning of Sunday, June 7, shortly before Adam Stone and his parents commenced their search of the park,
sentences.zh: 随后的6月7日星期日清晨，就在亚当·斯通和他的父母开始在公园搜寻之前不久，

sentences.en: a woman named Linda Guerrero was walking her pet beagle Bambi through the grounds.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫琳达·格雷罗的女子正带着她的宠物比格犬斑比在场地里散步。

sentences.en: As she passed some bushes near the top of a hill, Linda noticed two bodies entwined on the ground.
sentences.zh: 当她经过山顶附近的几处灌木丛时，琳达注意到地上有两具交织在一起的遗体。

sentences.en: From the angle where she was standing, Linda could see the bare back of one of the individuals.
sentences.zh: 从她站立的角度，琳达可以看到其中一个人赤裸的后背。

sentences.en: She assumed they were a couple asleep in an embrace.
sentences.zh: 她以为这是一对相拥而眠的情侣。

sentences.en: Sometimes unhoused people would sleep rough in Friant Country Park, so Linda wasn't particularly alarmed by the sight.
sentences.zh: 有时无家可归的人会露宿在弗里恩特郊野公园，所以琳达对这一幕并没有感到特别惊慌。

sentences.en: She called out,
sentences.zh: 她喊道，

sentences.en: When there was no reply, Linda continued on her way.
sentences.zh: 在没有任何回应后，琳达继续往前走。

sentences.en: She later phoned Streetlink, an organisation that helps rough sleepers in London, to report the incident.
sentences.zh: 她后来打电话给Streetlink（一个帮助伦敦露宿者的组织）报告了这起事件。

sentences.en: It wasn't until she learned of Bieber Henry and Nicole Smallman's murders that she realised the significance of what she had seen.
sentences.zh: 直到她得知比伯·亨利和妮可·斯莫尔曼被谋杀的消息，她才意识到自己所见之事的重大意义。

sentences.en: Friant Country Park remained closed off to the public while police scoured its grounds for further evidence.
sentences.zh: 弗里恩特郊野公园继续对公众封闭，而警察则在园区内搜寻更多证据。

sentences.en: A heavy downpour of rain across London on Saturday, June 6, the day before the sisters were found, led to fears that evidence had been washed away.
sentences.zh: 6月6日星期六（发现姐妹俩遗体的前一天），伦敦下一场大雨，这引发了人们对证据被冲走的担忧。

sentences.en: This rain was also the reason that the knife recovered at the crime scene appeared to be clean.
sentences.zh: 这场雨也是案发现场回收的凶器看起来很干净的原因。

sentences.en: But when investigators picked it up, they saw the underside was stained with blood.
sentences.zh: 但当调查人员拿起它时，他们看到背面沾满了血迹。

sentences.en: Testing revealed that the blood belonged to two different people,
sentences.zh: 检测表明，这些血迹属于两个人，

sentences.en: Nicole Smallman and an unidentified male.
sentences.zh: 妮可·斯莫尔曼和一个身份不明的男性。

sentences.en: Thanks to London's comprehensive network of CCTV cameras, investigators had been able to trace the sisters' actions in the lead-up to the picnic.
sentences.zh: 多亏了伦敦庞大的闭路电视监控网络，调查人员得以追踪到姐妹俩在野餐前夕的行动轨迹。

sentences.en: They had been captured on camera shopping for picnic supplies at a co-op supermarket, and one of the items they purchased was a bottle of tonic water.
sentences.zh: 她们被镜头拍到在一家合作社超市购买野餐用品，她们购买的物品之一就是一瓶汤力水。

sentences.en: The bottle was subsequently found in a bush near the women's bodies.
sentences.zh: 这瓶子随后在女性遗体附近的灌木丛中被发现。

sentences.en: It had blood on it.
sentences.zh: 上面有血迹。

sentences.en: Other bottles of rosé and prosecco recovered at the scene also had traces of blood on them.
sentences.zh: 现场回收的其他几瓶桃红葡萄酒和普罗塞克起泡酒上也有血迹痕迹。

sentences.en: A pair of blue latex gloves was also found.
sentences.zh: 现场还发现了一双蓝色乳胶手套。

sentences.en: One of the gloves was heavily stained with blood and damaged along the centre, as though slashed with a knife.
sentences.zh: 其中一只手套上沾满血迹，中间破损，就像被刀划破一样。

sentences.en: If the killer had been wearing the gloves, it appeared that they had suffered an injury during the attack, most likely when Nicole Smallman had fought back.
sentences.zh: 如果凶手当时戴着手套，那么看起来他们在袭击过程中受了伤，极有可能是妮可·斯莫尔曼进行反抗时造成的。

sentences.en: Investigators were able to obtain a DNA profile from the blood on the bottles, the glove and the discarded items that a member of the public had thrown away.
sentences.zh: 调查人员从瓶子上的血迹、手套以及公众扔掉的废弃物品中提取到了DNA图谱。

sentences.en: It was from the same unidentified male as the blood on the knife.
sentences.zh: 它与刀上血迹所属的未知名男性是同一个人。

sentences.en: This individual's blood was also found on some vegetation near the women's bodies, from one of Nicole's feet, and on Bieber's trainers, hand and leggings.
sentences.zh: 这个人的血迹也在女性遗体附近的植被上、妮可的一只脚上以及比伯的运动鞋、手部和打底裤上被发现。

sentences.en: This blood had likely been left when the killer dragged the women by their feet into the bushes.
sentences.zh: 这些血迹很可能是凶手拖着女性的脚将她们拉进灌木丛时留下的。

sentences.en: There was no record of this person in the national DNA database.
sentences.zh: 国家DNA数据库中没有此人的记录。

sentences.en: Divers searched a pond in the park for possible evidence.
sentences.zh: 潜水员搜查了公园里的一个池塘以寻找可能的证据。

sentences.en: They recovered two smartphones which had belonged to Bieber and Nicole.
sentences.zh: 他们找回了属于比伯和妮可的两部智能手机。

sentences.en: Their killer had seemingly taken them from the scene and subsequently disposed of them.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎把它们从现场拿走，随后又将其丢弃。

sentences.en: A forensic examination would reveal that the last contact they'd had with friends or family was when Nicole texted her boyfriend Adam just after 1am on the Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 法医检查显示，她们与朋友或家人的最后一次联系是妮可在星期六清晨1点刚过时给她的男友亚当发短信。

sentences.en: Between 1.26am and 3.48am, someone had repeatedly tried to gain access to Bieber Henry's phone.
sentences.zh: 在凌晨1点26分到3点48分之间，有人曾多次试图访问比伯·亨利的手机。

sentences.en: Its screen had been turned off and then on again at least 130 times.
sentences.zh: 它的屏幕被关闭然后又重新打开了至少130次。

sentences.en: Thanks to a step counter on the phone, police could see that whoever had been holding it had walked about 1.3 miles during that time,
sentences.zh: 多亏了手机上的计步器，警方能够看到持有它的人在那段时间里大约走了1.3英里，

sentences.en: before switching the phone off and throwing it into the pond.
sentences.zh: 然后才关掉手机并把它扔进了池塘。

sentences.en: Also found on the device were a number of photos that the sisters had taken throughout the night.
sentences.zh: 在该设备上还发现了姐妹俩整晚拍摄的大量照片。

sentences.en: There were shots of them celebrating with their friends, and then pictures of just the two of them after everyone else had gone home.
sentences.zh: 有她们和朋友庆祝的照片，然后是其他人回家后仅剩她们俩的照片。

sentences.en: Bieber and Nicole had set up a timer on the phone's camera, draped themselves with fairy lights, and snapped more than a hundred pictures as they laughed and danced in the dark.
sentences.zh: 比伯和妮可在手机相机上设置了定时器，身上披着彩灯，在黑暗中一边笑一边跳舞，拍了一百多张照片。

sentences.en: The final photograph was taken at 1.13am.
sentences.zh: 最后一张照片拍摄于凌晨1点13分。

sentences.en: In this image, the women appeared distracted.
sentences.zh: 在这张照片中，女性显得有些心不在焉。

sentences.en: Instead of posing like they had in the other shots, both were looking to their left, as though something in that direction had drawn their attention.
sentences.zh: 两人没有像在其他照片中那样摆姿势，而是都看着她们的左边，仿佛那个方向有什么东西吸引了她们的注意力。

sentences.en: Detectives suspected that this was the moment their attacker had made himself known.
sentences.zh: 侦探们怀疑，这就是她们的袭击者现身的那一刻。

sentences.en: No one who knew Bieber and Nicole could think of anyone who would want to harm them.
sentences.zh: 任何认识比伯和妮可的人都想不出会有谁想要伤害她们。

sentences.en: Bieber was a highly respected and popular senior social worker at Buckinghamshire Council, who went above and beyond for the children she worked with.
sentences.zh: 比伯是白金汉郡议会一位备受尊敬且深受欢迎的高级社会工作者，她为自己共事过的孩子们付出了超越职责的努力。

sentences.en: Bieber had her own daughter, whom she adored, and was about to become a grandmother for the first time.
sentences.zh: 比伯有她自己的女儿，她对女儿疼爱有加，并且即将第一次当上祖母。

sentences.en: She made friends easily and was well-liked for her positive demeanour.
sentences.zh: 她很容易结交朋友，并因其积极的为人态度而广受喜爱。

sentences.en: Nicole worked as a freelance photographer and shared her sister's upbeat outlook on life.
sentences.zh: 妮可是一名自由摄影师，和她姐姐一样对生活抱着乐观的态度。

sentences.en: Her parents often joked that she should have been born in the 1960s, as she was a flower child at heart who cared deeply about social justice, animals, and the natural world.
sentences.zh: 她的父母经常开玩笑说她应该出生在20世纪60年代，因为她内心是一个崇尚自由的花童，深深关切着社会正义、动物和自然世界。

sentences.en: For the past six years, she had been in a relationship with her boyfriend, Adam Stone.
sentences.zh: 在过去的六年里，她一直和男友亚当·斯通保持着恋爱关系。

sentences.en: The couple had lived together with Adam's parents for a while, but Nicole had recently moved into a flat with a housemate.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣曾与亚当的父母同住了一段时间，但妮可最近搬进了一套和室友合租的公寓。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the pair remained as close as ever.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，两人的关系依然一如既往地亲密。

sentences.en: Prior to Nicole leaving for Bieber's party,
sentences.zh: 在妮可出发去比伯的聚会之前，

sentences.en: Adam had made sure to give her money so she could catch a cab home.
sentences.zh: 亚当特意给了她钱，好让她坐出租车回家。

sentences.en: Bieber and Nicole also had good relationships with their family members, who were highly respected members of the community.
sentences.zh: 比伯和妮可与她们的家庭成员关系也很好，他们的家人都是社区里备受尊敬的成员。

sentences.en: Their mother, Mina, was a retired archdeacon in the Anglican Church.
sentences.zh: 她们的母亲米娜是英国圣公会的一名退休副主教。

sentences.en: Mina's father was Nigerian, and she had been the first black woman to hold that title.
sentences.zh: 米娜的父亲是尼日利亚人，她是第一位获得该头衔的黑人女性。

sentences.en: There was nothing in either of the women's lives that pointed to them being targeted by someone they knew.
sentences.zh: 这两个女性的生活中没有任何迹象表明她们成为她们认识的人的目标。

sentences.en: This appeared to be confirmed by the killer's DNA recovered at the scene.
sentences.zh: 现场提取的凶手DNA似乎证实了这一点。

sentences.en: The fact that it belonged to an unknown male suggested to police that the sisters had been victims of a random attack.
sentences.zh: 它属于一个未知名男性的事实向警方表明，姐妹俩是随机袭击的受害者。

sentences.en: Detectives went public with this information, telling journalists that the women were murdered by a stranger and they needed the public's help to find him.
sentences.zh: 侦探们将这一信息公之于众，告诉记者这两名女性是被一个陌生人谋杀的，他们需要公众的帮助来找到他。

sentences.en: The suspect they were looking for had likely suffered an injury during the attack, which resulted in significant bleeding.
sentences.zh: 他们寻找的嫌疑人在袭击过程中可能受了伤，导致了大量出血。

sentences.en: If anyone had seen somebody injured or acting suspiciously around the Friant Country Park area, they were urged to report what they knew.
sentences.zh: 如果任何人看到有人受伤或在弗里恩特郊野公园地区行为可疑，他们被敦促报告他们所知道的情况。

sentences.en: A few leads trickled in.
sentences.zh: 有一些线索陆陆续续地传来。

sentences.en: Local residents said there had recently been a man hanging about the park following women.
sentences.zh: 当地居民说，最近有一个五十多岁的男子在公园里游荡并尾随女性。

sentences.en: He was aged in his 50s.
sentences.zh: 他的年龄在50多岁。

sentences.en: While pursuing these tip-offs, police arrested several different men, but all of them were later released without charges.
sentences.zh: 在追查这些线索的同时，警方逮捕了几个不同的男人，但后来他们都无罪释放了。

sentences.en: Some people, including the sister's mother, Mina, felt that the brutal double murder wasn't receiving enough press attention to generate worthwhile leads.
sentences.zh: 一些人，包括姐妹俩的母亲米娜，认为这起残忍的双重谋杀案没有得到足够的媒体关注来产生有价值的线索。

sentences.en: Although London's media had reported on the crime, it wasn't receiving front-page coverage or a national spotlight.
sentences.zh: 尽管伦敦的媒体报道了这起犯罪，但它并没有登上头版头条或成为全国关注的焦点。

sentences.en: Users of the online forum, web sleuths, complained that they hadn't even heard about the murders until stumbling across a thread on the website.
sentences.zh: 网络论坛“网络侦探”的用户抱怨说，直到偶然看到网站上的一个帖子，他们才听说这些谋杀案。

sentences.en: The subdued nature of the coverage seemed at odds with the terrifying nature of the random attack.
sentences.zh: 报道的低调性质似乎与随机袭击的可怕性质不相符。

sentences.en: Then, two weeks after the murders, news broke that finally seemed to capture the press's attention.
sentences.zh: 然后，在谋杀案发生两周后，终于引起媒体关注的消息传开了。

sentences.en: In June of 2020, 32-year-old police constable Jamie Lewis had worked as an officer with the Metropolitan Police Service for just over nine months.
sentences.zh: 2020年6月，32岁的警员杰米·刘易斯在伦敦警察厅担任警官刚满九个月。

sentences.en: Prior to joining the Met, as it was known, Lewis had spent several years with the British Transport Police.
sentences.zh: 在加入伦敦警察厅（正如人们所知的那样）之前，刘易斯曾在英国交通警察局工作过几年。

sentences.en: At 3.30am on the morning of Monday, June 8, 2020, Lewis arrived at Friant Country Park with a number of his colleagues.
sentences.zh: 2020年6月8日星期一清晨3点30分，刘易斯和他的多名同事抵达弗里恩特郊野公园。

sentences.en: The bodies of Beaver Henry and Nicole Smallman had been found in the park roughly 15 hours earlier and officers were needed to guard the scene overnight until the bodies could be safely removed.
sentences.zh: 比弗·亨利和妮可·斯莫尔曼的遗体大约在15小时前在公园里被发现，需要警官连夜守卫现场，直到遗体被安全移走。

sentences.en: Jamie Lewis and several colleagues were assigned to the cordon closest to the sisters' bodies, which weren't visible from where they were standing.
sentences.zh: 杰米·刘易斯和几名同事被指派到离姐妹俩遗体最近的警戒线，从他们站立的地方看不到遗体。

sentences.en: The officers were told the general location within the thicket where the women lay, but weren't shown the bodies.
sentences.zh: 警官们被告知了女性躺着的灌木丛内的大致位置，但没有让他们看遗体。

sentences.en: None were wearing full-barrier forensic clothing.
sentences.zh: 没有人穿着全隔离法医防护服。

sentences.en: They were not to search the woodland area.
sentences.zh: 他们不得搜查林地地区。

sentences.en: Their job was simply to keep watch and to make sure no one entered the scene in order to preserve its integrity.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作只是守望，并确保没有人进入现场，以维护其完整性。

sentences.en: Each of the four officers was given a separate post to guard and told they must remain in place until colleagues arrived to relieve them.
sentences.zh: 四名警官每人都被分配了一个单独的岗位进行看守，并被告知必须坚守岗位，直到同事到达换班。

sentences.en: Under no circumstances were they to enter the bushes where the women's bodies lay.
sentences.zh: 在任何情况下，他们都不得进入女性遗体所在的灌木丛。

sentences.en: At 3.50am, about 20 minutes after arriving at the park, Jamie Lewis took out his phone and opened the messaging application WhatsApp.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点50分，在到达公园大约20分钟后，杰米·刘易斯掏出手机，打开了聊天应用程序WhatsApp。

sentences.en: He then typed a message to a group chat labelled The A-Team.
sentences.zh: 然后他给一个名为“A小队”的群聊发了一条消息。

sentences.en: Me, Izzy, Dennis and Matt are living the Wembley dream.
sentences.zh: 我和伊兹、丹尼斯和马特正在过着温布利式的梦想生活。

sentences.en: He attached a photo of a forensic tent set up at the park, then hit send.
sentences.zh: 他附上了一张在公园里搭建的法医帐篷的照片，然后点击发送。

sentences.en: The group chat consisted of 41 different metropolitan police officers.
sentences.zh: 该群聊由41名不同的伦敦警察组成。

sentences.en: One soon sent a reply,
sentences.zh: 其中一人很快发来回复，

sentences.en: Enjoying the sunrise.
sentences.zh: 享受日出呢。

sentences.en: Lewis responded,
sentences.zh: 刘易斯回应道，

sentences.en: Unfortunately, I'm sat next to two dead birds full of stab wounds.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我正坐在两只身上满是刀伤的死鸟旁边。

sentences.en: Another officer replied with a joke about Lewis's use of the slang term birds, referring to women.
sentences.zh: 另一名警官回复了一个关于刘易斯使用俚语“鸟”（指代女性）的笑话。

sentences.en: He asked,
sentences.zh: 他问道，

sentences.en: Who's been out stabbing pigeons?
sentences.zh: 谁跑出去捅鸽子了？

sentences.en: Lewis responded by sending a photograph he'd taken of Bieber and Nicole's bodies, despite being instructed not to breach the cordon.
sentences.zh: 刘易斯回应说，他发送了一张他拍摄的比伯和妮可遗体的照片，尽管他被指示不得突破警戒线。

sentences.en: One of Lewis's colleagues from the North East London Police Station,
sentences.zh: 刘易斯在伦敦警察局东北警局的一位同事，

sentences.en: 45-year-old police constable Dennis Jaffa, was also using WhatsApp to message nine of his friends in another group chat.
sentences.zh: 45岁的警员丹尼斯·贾法也在使用WhatsApp在另一个群聊中给他的九个朋友发信息。

sentences.en: He sent the group a Daily Mail article about the double homicide and informed them that he was at the scene now.
sentences.zh: 他向群里发送了一篇关于这起双重谋杀案的《每日邮报》文章，并告知他们他现在就在现场。

sentences.en: He would try to take some photos of the bodies to share with them.
sentences.zh: 他会试着拍一些遗体的照片与他们分享。

sentences.en: Over the next several hours,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个小时里，

sentences.en: Lewis and Jaffa repeatedly left their posts to walk back and forth to chat with each other.
sentences.zh: 刘易斯和贾法多次离开岗位，来回走动互相聊天。

sentences.en: Both breached the cordon to take multiple up-close photographs of Bieber and Nicole.
sentences.zh: 两人都突破了警戒线，拍下了多张比伯和妮可的近距离照片。

sentences.en: Jaffa took four photographs, while Lewis took two.
sentences.zh: 贾法拍了四张照片，刘易斯拍了两张。

sentences.en: Lewis edited one photo in the social media app Snapchat to superimpose his face next to the bodies, as though he'd taken a selfie with them.
sentences.zh: 刘易斯在社交媒体应用Snapchat上编辑了一张照片，将他的脸叠加在遗体旁边，就好像他和她们拍了自拍一样。

sentences.en: Both men shared some of their photos with friends who didn't work with the police, and told them that the two victims were a 14-year-old and a pregnant 20-year-old.
sentences.zh: 两人与不在警察局工作的朋分享了他们的一些照片，并告诉他们这两个受害者是一个14岁的女孩和一个怀孕的20岁女孩。

sentences.en: It is unclear where they obtained this incorrect information.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚他们是从哪里获得这些错误信息的。

sentences.en: Lewis referred to Bieber and Nicole as two stabbed-up-dead women.
sentences.zh: 刘易斯将比伯和妮可称为两个被捅死的女人。

sentences.en: When Jaffa was asked by a friend if the crime scene was bad, he replied, Not really, I've seen worse.
sentences.zh: 当贾法被朋友问及犯罪现场是否糟糕时，他回答说，一般般，我见过更糟糕的。

sentences.en: Lewis also showed the photos on his phone to several different people in person.
sentences.zh: 刘易斯还向现场的几个人当面展示了他手机上的照片。

sentences.en: Two of these were police officers, one was a female probationary officer.
sentences.zh: 其中两人是警察，一个是女性见习警官。

sentences.en: She was disgusted by the photographs, and told Lewis his actions were inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 她对这些照片感到厌恶，并告诉刘易斯他的行为很不妥。

sentences.en: At least one member of the A-Team WhatsApp group who had been sent similar photos agreed and reported the matter to their higher-ups at the Metropolitan Police.
sentences.zh: A小队WhatsApp群聊中至少有一名被发送了类似照片的成员对此表示赞同，并向伦敦警察局的高层汇报了此事。

sentences.en: On Friday June 19, the Independent Office for Police Conduct, also known as the IOPC, was alerted.
sentences.zh: 6月19日星期五，独立警察行为办公室（也被称为IOPC）收到了警报。

sentences.en: Three days later,
sentences.zh: 三天后，

sentences.en: Lewis and Jaffa had their phones seized and were arrested for misconduct in public office.
sentences.zh: 刘易斯和贾法被扣押了手机，并因公职人员行为不检被捕。

sentences.en: During an examination of Jaffa's phone, it was found he'd also used a racist term to refer to South Asian men.
sentences.zh: 在对贾法手机的检查中，人们发现他还曾用种族主义词汇称呼南亚裔男子。

sentences.en: When Lewis received a text using that same term, he made no objection.
sentences.zh: 当刘易斯收到一条使用相同词汇的信息时，他没有提出异议。

sentences.en: The Met issued a press release about the arrests, and the story quickly made headlines across the UK.
sentences.zh: 伦敦警察厅就这些逮捕事件发布了新闻稿，该事件迅速成为英国各大媒体的头条新闻。

sentences.en: Bieber and Nicole's family had the news broken to them in person by a member of the IOPC.
sentences.zh: 独立警察投诉局（IOPC）的一名成员亲自将这一消息告知了比伯和妮可的家人。

sentences.en: For Mina Smallman and the sisters' other loved ones, this was the final straw.
sentences.zh: 对于米娜·斯莫尔曼以及姐妹俩的其他亲人来说，这成了压垮他们的最后一根稻草。

sentences.en: They had felt from the start that Bieber and Nicole's case hadn't been taken seriously.
sentences.zh: 他们从一开始就觉得比伯和妮可的案子没有受到重视。

sentences.en: First, there had been the delayed police response when they were reported missing.
sentences.zh: 首先，在他们被报告失踪时，警方的反应就存在延迟。

sentences.en: Mina put this down to racism and classism.
sentences.zh: 米娜将此归咎于种族主义和阶级偏见。

sentences.en: Both her daughters were of Nigerian heritage and Bieber lived in a public housing flat in Wembley, a predominantly black neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 她的两个女儿都有尼日利亚血统，而且比伯住在温布利的一个公共住房公寓里，那是一个黑人居多的社区。

sentences.en: As she told the BBC,
sentences.zh: 正如她对BBC所说的那样，

sentences.en: Cases involving missing white women from middle-class backgrounds seemed to be taken more seriously by the media as well.
sentences.zh: 媒体似乎对中产阶级背景的失踪白人女性的案件更加重视。

sentences.en: Mina Smallman would later note that the story about the officers' misconduct generated far more media attention than the women's disappearance and murder had.
sentences.zh: 米娜·斯莫尔曼后来指出，关于警员不当行为的新闻所引起的媒体关注，远超这两名女性失踪和遇害案本身。

sentences.en: But that didn't mean Mina thought the misconduct was unworthy of attention.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着米娜认为这些不当行为不值得关注。

sentences.en: The news that her daughter's dignity had been further degraded by two people charged with protecting them was utterly devastating for the grieving mother.
sentences.zh: 对于这位悲痛的母亲来说，女儿们的尊严遭到那些本应保护她们的人的进一步践踏，这个消息简直是毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: As she said in an interview with The Guardian,
sentences.zh: 正如她在接受《卫报》采访时所说，

sentences.en: Mina hadn't even imagined what her daughter's bodies looked like until she learnt officers took photos of them.
sentences.zh: 米娜甚至从未想象过她女儿们的尸体是什么样子的，直到她得知警员给她们拍了照。

sentences.en: She was already barely holding on by a thread and now she suddenly began having images flash through her mind of what the crime scene might have looked like.
sentences.zh: 她本就濒于崩溃，而现在，她的脑海中突然开始闪现案发现场可能是什么样子的画面。

sentences.en: Her pain somehow deepened.
sentences.zh: 她的痛苦在某种程度上加深了。

sentences.en: Mina told the BBC, quote,
sentences.zh: 米娜对BBC说道，原话是：

sentences.en: This has taken our grief to another place.
sentences.zh: 这把我们的悲伤带到了另一个境界。

sentences.en: If we ever needed an example of how toxic it has become, those police officers felt so safe, so untouchable, that they felt they could take photographs
sentences.zh: 如果我们还需要一个例子来证明这种毒害有多深的话，那些警察觉得如此安全、如此不可触碰，以至于他们觉得自己可以拍下

sentences.en: of dead black girls and send them on.
sentences.zh: 已故黑人女孩的照片并转发出去。

sentences.en: It speaks volumes of the ethos that runs through the Metropolitan Police.
sentences.zh: 这充分说明了贯穿伦敦警察厅的精神风貌。

sentences.en: Bieber and Nicole's friends and family were horrified to think that while they had been standing vigil at the park, desperate for one final glimpse of their loved ones,
sentences.zh: 比伯和妮可的朋友和家人感到惊恐万分，因为当他们曾在公园里守夜、渴望最后一眼见到亲人时，

sentences.en: members of the police were taking dehumanising photographs of them and making crass jokes.
sentences.zh: 警察局的成员却在拍摄非人化的照片并开着粗俗的玩笑。

sentences.en: In the BBC documentary Two Daughters, one of Bieber's cousins stated,
sentences.zh: 在BBC纪录片《两个女儿》中，比伯的一位表亲表示：

sentences.en: those two police officers did something worse than them being murdered.
sentences.zh: 那两名警察做的事情比她们被谋杀还要糟糕。

sentences.en: We can't change that, but the dignity that they deserved in their death, they took that from them and I will never forgive them for that.
sentences.zh: 我们无法改变这一点，但她们在死后本应享有的尊严，被他们无情剥夺了，我永远不会原谅他们。

sentences.en: In the wake of the misconduct allegations,
sentences.zh: 在不当行为指控曝光之后，

sentences.en: the family and the public's trust in the Metropolitan Police Service took a severe hit.
sentences.zh: 家属以及公众对伦敦警察厅的信任受到了沉重打击。

sentences.en: Despite this, detectives continued working to solve the case.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，侦探们仍在继续努力侦破此案。

sentences.en: The suspect's DNA hadn't matched anyone in the National DNA Database, so detectives asked the National Crime Agency to run it against their records for a familial match.
sentences.zh: 嫌疑人的DNA与国家DNA数据库中的任何人都不匹配，因此侦探们要求国家犯罪局将其与他们的记录进行比对，以寻找血缘匹配者。

sentences.en: This time, there was a hit.
sentences.zh: 这一次，有了匹配结果。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, June 30, detectives discovered their suspect was related to a man named Kamal Hussain who had previously received a caution.
sentences.zh: 6月30日星期二，侦探们发现他们的嫌疑人与一名曾受过训诫的男子卡迈尔·侯赛因有亲属关系。

sentences.en: The DNA indicated the suspect was a close family member of Kamal's, most likely his child.
sentences.zh: DNA显示，该嫌疑人是卡迈尔的近亲，极有可能是他的孩子。

sentences.en: Kamal was from an Iraqi Kurdish background and had four children with his ex-wife who resided on the south side of London in Eltham.
sentences.zh: 卡迈尔具有伊拉克库尔德人血统，与前妻育有四个孩子，前妻住在伦敦南部埃尔特姆。

sentences.en: All of the children were school-aged, with the eldest being just 18 years old.
sentences.zh: 所有孩子都在上学年龄，最大的也才18岁。

sentences.en: Kamal had often worried about his firstborn, who was a boy named Daniel.

sentences.zh: 尼科尔的伴侣亚当讲述了他失去她的悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: To put into words how I feel about losing Nicole is almost impossible, especially in this unimaginable and horrifically violent way.
sentences.zh: 要把我对失去尼科尔的感受用言语表达出来几乎是不可能的，尤其是以这种无法想象的、极其暴力的方式。

sentences.en: Nicole is my first thought, my second, and every thought thereafter, and if I am lucky enough to fall asleep, then I see her in my dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 尼科尔是我第一个想到的，第二个，也是之后每一个想到的，如果我有幸入睡，我就会在梦里见到她。

sentences.en: This is all I have left of her.
sentences.zh: 这就是她留给我的全部了。

sentences.en: Nicole was the only child of her schoolteacher father,
sentences.zh: 尼科尔是身为教师的父亲的独生女，

sentences.en: Chris, and had been particularly close to him.
sentences.zh: 克里斯，并且一直与他特别亲近。

sentences.en: Mina Smallman told The Guardian,
sentences.zh: 米娜·斯莫尔曼告诉《卫报》，

sentences.en: I remember watching him kissing her newborn head.
sentences.zh: 我记得看着他亲吻她刚出生的头顶。

sentences.en: He was completely smitten.
sentences.zh: 他彻底被迷住了。

sentences.en: For a man who is not sentimental, it was a beautiful thing to see.
sentences.zh: 对于一个并不多愁善感的男人来说，那是一个美好的画面。

sentences.zh: 在BBC纪录片

sentences.zh: 《两个女儿》中，

sentences.en: Mina concluded by saying she wanted people to remember how her daughters lived, not how they died.
sentences.zh: 米娜最后说，她希望人们记住她女儿们是如何生活的，而不是她们是如何死去的。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: Bieber, the amazing social worker who battled to make sure children were safe, that families weren't broken up.
sentences.zh: 比伯，这位出色的社会工作者，为确保孩子们的安全、不让家庭破碎而奋斗。

sentences.en: And Nikki, she was just a ray of light everywhere, and I know that will always be the way.
sentences.zh: 还有妮基，她无时无刻不在散发着光芒，我知道这永远都会是这样。

sentences.en: And I think that's what we need to do.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是我们需要做的。

sentences.en: We need to find the sunshine in the rain.
sentences.zh: 我们需要在雨中寻找阳光。
